tv_reconstruct — TOMOGRAPHY ct_scan op

• 数据种类:projstack × ctgeometry → voxel

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.tv_reconstruct(projections, geometry, tv_weight=0.0003, n_iter=200, initial=None, nonnegative=True, device='auto', on_iter=None)(要直接调用实现,import ctscan; ctscan.tv_reconstruct(projections, geometry, tv_weight=0.0003, n_iter=200, initial=None, nonnegative=True, device='auto', on_iter=None);从台账取用则 opstomography.get("tv_reconstruct"))

• GPU:无(仅 CPU 参考实现)

用法

基于 Chambolle-Pock 原始对偶法的全变分重建。

> 以下的详细说明为原文 —— 摘要与标题已翻译。

Solves min 0.5 ||A x - p||^2 + w ||grad x||_1 with x >= 0, in the form Sidky, Jorgensen & Pan 2012 give for CT. The prior says that the object is piecewise constant, which is what lets it fill data that was never measured: few views and limited angle. On an object that is not piecewise constant it paints the same flat patches, so a low residual here is not evidence of truth.

*tv_weight* is in units of ||A||^2 times the volume scale, so that one value behaves alike across grid sizes.

:param projections: (view, V, U) line integrals. :param geometry: dict from ct_scan_geometry. :param tv_weight: strength of the prior, >= 0. :param n_iter: primal-dual iterations, 1 .. 5000. :param initial: starting volume; None gives zeros. :param nonnegative: enforce x >= 0. :param device: "auto", "cpu" or "cuda". :param on_iter: optional on_iter(iteration, volume); returning a boolean

True (bool or numpy.bool_) stops after that iteration, any other

return value is ignored (same rule as sirt_reconstruct).

:returns: (Z, Y, X) float volume. :raises ValueError: on a shape that disagrees with the geometry or a negative

weight. Empty input (projections with 0 elements) raises ValueError.
